model_architecture: Gradient Boosted Decision Trees (XGBoost) + Monotonic Fairness Constraints
training_data_summary: Anonymized retail credit repayment history across 180,000 EU/DE loan accounts (2019-2025), excluding prohibited protected attributes and audited for historical bias.
known_limitations: Lower thin-file scoring accuracy for young borrowers (Age_18_25) with limited credit history; requires compensating controls and manual credit review.

model_architecture: 3D Convolutional Neural Network (ResNet-50 Backbone) + Uncertainty Calibration
training_data_summary: De-identified cardiac imaging and clinical triage records (GDPR Art. 9 compliant) from partner European hospitals under ISO 13485 data governance controls.
known_limitations: Reduced sensitivity on elderly (Age_75_Plus) and female patient cohorts as well as sub-minimum validation sample size; requires specialist review and abstention fallback.

model_architecture: Instruction-Tuned Transformer LLM + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Guardrails
training_data_summary: Curated insurance policy documentation, German claims FAQ corpora, and synthetic red-team prompt pairs scrubbed of customer PII.
known_limitations: Slight accuracy drop on heavy regional German dialects and non-native phrasing; does not replace binding policy coverage determinations.
